Container.Name: arcade
Container.Overview: The au12 Arcade: one installable app for every self-hosted game on your shelf (Totem, Space Cadet, Nanosaur, Marble Drop, Chalkfall, Swipe, Tradecraft, Pazaak and your own). Family players with pixel avatars, high scores and records across the games, tickets and a prize counter, achievements, and an attract-mode kiosk for a real cabinet. Each game sets ARCADE_URL to this container's address.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: The database: players, scores, tickets, settings

Config.Name: Public address
Config.Description: Where the arcade is reached (https://arcade.example.com). Used for links and QR codes.

Config.Name: Games' domain
Config.Description: Games are found at https://<game>.<this domain> (totem., swipe., …). Point any one elsewhere in the admin page or with GAME_<ID>_URL.

Config.Name: Admin password
Config.Description: Turns on the admin page at /admin. Keep /admin to your own network at the proxy.

Config.Name: Arcade name
Config.Description: Shown on the marquee, in the attract loop and as the installed app's name

Config.Name: Trust proxy
Config.Description: How many reverse proxies are in front (1 for Nginx Proxy Manager, 0 for none)

Config.Name: Open sign-up
Config.Description: Anyone who opens the arcade can add a player. false makes it an admin job.

Container.Changes: ### 1.0.0 - The arcade: players, cross-game high scores, tickets, prizes, achievements, the kiosk.
